papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware with varying resource constraints, the ability to adaptively manage the trade-off between performance and efficiency without retraining is critical. links.title: Smarter Saboteurs, Better Fixers: Scaling & Security in Linear Multi-Agent Workflows

primary_link.title: Smarter Saboteurs, Better Fixers: Scaling & Security in Linear Multi-Agent Workflows

papers.summary: As LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) are deployed in the wild, the resilience of their collaboration structures against adversarial compromise becomes a critical safety concern. primary_link.title: SMSR: Certified Defence Against Runtime Memory Poisoning in Persistent LLM Agent Systems

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents increasingly run with persistent memory that accumulates across user sessions. primary_link.title: CAPED: Context-Aware Privacy Exposure Defense for Mobile GUI Agents

papers.summary: Screenshot-based mobile GUI agents can operate ordinary smartphone apps through the same visual interface as a human user, but this capability also turns every screen observation into a privacy boundary. primary_link.title: "Did you lie?" Evaluating Lie Detectors across Model Scale and Belief-Verified Model Organisms

links.title: PROJECTMEM: A Local-First, Event-Sourced Memory and Judgment Layer for AI Coding Agents

papers.summary_zh: AI 程式碼助手現已支援從快速腳本到生產應用程式的日益增長的軟體工作份額。然而這些智能體在很大程度上仍是無狀態的：每個新會話都會重新讀取專案檔案、重新推導先前的決策，並且——最昂貴的是——可能重複已經失敗的除錯嘗試。重建這些上下文每個會話估計消耗 5000 至 20000 個 token，瓶頸往往不在模型能力，而是缺乏專案記憶。本文提出 projectmem，一個開源、本地優先、事件溯源的記憶與判斷層，專為 AI 程式碼智能體設計。它透過持續記錄專案狀態與決策歷史，使智能體能在跨會話中保留上下文，顯著減少重複操作，提升開發效率。

links.title: Efficient On-Device Diffusion LLM Inference with Mobile NPU

primary_link.title: Efficient On-Device Diffusion LLM Inference with Mobile NPU

papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate generation by denoising multiple tokens in parallel, making them attractive for latency-sensitive mobile inference. primary_link.title: Brick: Spatial Capability Routing for the Mixture-of-Models (MoM) Paradigm

primary_link.title: Layer-Resolved Optimal Transport for Hallucination Detection in NMT and Abstractive Summarization

papers.summary: Optimal transport (OT) has been shown to detect hallucinations in neural machine translation (NMT) by measuring the geometric distance between cross-attention distributions and a reference distribution, without any supervision. papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional general language processing capabilities, but their memory and compute costs hinder deployment. primary_link.title: SafeLLM: Extraction as a Hallucination-Resistant Alternative to Rewriting in Safety-Critical Settings

primary_link.title: HarnessBridge: Learnable Bidirectional Controller for LLM Agent Harness

radar.summary_zh: 現有電腦使用代理在專業軟體操作上存在根本限制：基於 GUI 的代理受制於脆弱的視覺定位與長時域誤差累積，而基於 API 的方法則難以處理異質協定與不可存取的商業介面。本文識別出 Component Object Model（COM）作為一種統一的、可執行的抽象層，提出 COM-as-Action 新典範：將專業軟體互動重新框架為確定性的程式呼叫，繞過 GUI 與 API 的限制。實驗證明，ComAct 在多個主流專業軟體（如 Office 套件、IDE）上能實現穩定且高效的自動化操作，為專業軟體操控提供了新的可行性路徑。

radar.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）透過生成長的中間推理鏈來改善複雜問題解決能力，但這顯著增加了推理成本。NVFP4 推理透過硬體支援的低精度執行提供了一種降低計算與記憶體成本的有效方案。然而，直接將 NVFP4 應用於 LRM 會帶來兩個實際限制：量化導致推理準確率下降，且現有 NVFP4 核心無法在序列長度變化時充分實現延遲優勢。本文提出 ReSET，一種步驟感知的溫度縮放方法，在推理過程中根據推理步驟動態調整縮放因子，保持低精度的同時顯著恢復準確率，並設計了針對變長序列的延遲優化核心。結果表明，ReSET 能在幾乎不損失準確率的情況下實現接近 2 倍的推理加速。

Existing red-teaming approaches for MAS remain limited: they rely on heuristic selection of target age
top5.summary_zh: 層級式多智能體系統（MAS）正快速部署於金融、軟體工程等高風險領域，但其安全漏洞分散於角色專用智能體之間，攻擊面因而顯著擴大，尤其是特權提升與跨智能體共謀等協同行為。現有紅隊測試方法多依賴啟發式選擇目標，缺乏系統性。本文提出 MAStrike，利用 Shapley 值引導的共謀紅隊策略，自動識別多智能體系統中的關鍵弱點。此方法有效提升了大規模 AI 系統安全評估的全面性與效率。
